title: Stock-source Engrave, Trace and the typed 2D kinds cut the part with no op finding and post on a turned stock

labels.name: P1
labels.description: Unsafe or wrong output: gouge, collision, wrong G-code, crash, data loss; blocks a cut

labels.name: in-review
labels.description: Fix pushed on a branch with an open PR; merges at the next cut

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
**What happens:** a 2D operation whose source is the **stock** (or a pick off the setup's stock) carries no part law on the operation (`part_solid` is false, so `depth_law_of` returns `DepthLaw::None` before the kind's arm). When the stock holds a part and the cut reaches into it, the operation has 0 findings. With the stock aligned the program sim blocks the post; with the stock **turned** (the sim refuses to judge) the post goes out.

Found while working #1595 / #1603 (branch `issue/1595-engrave-law`, upstream main 745edc36 plus that branch).

**Probe:** the #1585 fixture (40 x 40 x 8 block, R15 pocket to Z4, EM-0600-4FL) in a 40 x 40 x 8 box stock centred over it. Engrave / Trace, source `Stock`, Top Z8, Bottom Z1 (the stock's outline is the part's outline, so the line runs down the part's outside wall):

| kind | op findings | stock aligned | stock turned 90 deg about Z |
|---|---|---|---|
| Engrave | 0 | blocked by the program sim ("worst 7.00 mm") | **posts** |
| Trace | 0 | blocked by the program sim ("worst 7.00 mm") | **posts** |

The same holds by construction for the other kinds that are judged only on a part source: Slot, Trochoidal slot, Circular (`authored_law`), Contour and Face (`Section`). #1593 pinned the stock-source Trochoidal slot as never judged (`a_trochoid_on_the_stock_is_never_judged`); these were not probed here.

**What #1603's fix covers and what it leaves:** the pocket family (2D Pocket, 2D Adaptive, 2D Offset) on a stock source is now judged against the setup's parts (`operation::keep_law::parts_in_stock`, the mesh the program sim judges against). The job carries those parts only for that family. Every other kind on a stock source is still unjudged on the operation.

**Expected:** a stock-source operation in a setup that holds a part is judged against that part by the law its kind takes on a part source (Mark for Engrave / Trace, with the sim's mark credit extended to match; Section for the typed kinds, Contour and Face), or the decision that the stock source is never judged is restated with a refusal where the program sim cannot judge. Either way the aligned and the turned stock give the same verdict.

**Not simply `uncovered()`:** refusing every None-law op when the sim cannot judge would refuse a legal stock-source Face on any turned stock (see `docs/decisions/1595-engrave-mark-law.md`).

**Done means:** the probe rows above are refused on the operation by name (or the post is blocked) on both stocks; a legal stock-source cut that stays off the part (a Face above it, a Contour round the stock) still posts on both; `a_trochoid_on_the_stock_is_never_judged` is kept or replaced by a stated decision; pinned through generate and the post, mutation-checked.

Related: #1603, #1595, #1593, #1554.
